source: Telegramme228 / togoactualite.com, 'Deuxieme deces lie au cholera a Kpalime, 15 patients hospitalises!', 1 October 2014 (quotes a CHP Kpalime health source)
processing_notes: Source states: '2 morts pour cause de cholera et 15 autres patients hospitalises au Centre Hospitalier Prefectoral (CHP) de Kpalime. C'est le bilan de l'epidemie de cholera declenchee il y a quelques jours a Kpalime dans la prefecture de Kloto. [...] D'apres nos informations, ce bilan de 2 morts et 15 malades confirmes et hospitalises, ne concerne que le CHP de Kpalime' - interpreted as 15 sCh cases, 2 deaths. Interpreted as 15 sCh cases and 2 deaths. FACILITY-LEVEL, NOT A DISTRICT TOTAL: the source states explicitly that the figure covers only the Centre Hospitalier Prefectoral de Kpalime and that what was happening in the USP and other health centres of Kloto prefecture was unknown to it - so this is a floor for Kpalime town, not a count for Kloto district; do not sum with the Kloto district rows. TL = 2014-09-22, the week in which the source places the first death ('un premier cas de deces signale la semaine dernière'); the second death is dated precisely ('hier mardi, 30 septembre'). Index case described as a woman returning from a funeral in GHANA who infected co-residents of the Kligue-Kondji quarter - a cross-border importation claim worth following up (Agent 2/5). Level 3 press (Telegramme228 via togoactualite.com) quoting an unnamed hospital source, hence confidence 0.4. CONSISTENCY: Rebaudet et al. 2018 Table 2 (AI row 224) gives Kloto 26 cases and 3 deaths for the whole of 2011-2014, which contains this episode.

Le troisieme deces avait ete enregistre mi-octobre dernier. [19 Oct 2014 piece: 'un troisieme deces [...] a appris l'Agence Savoir News de source hospitaliere. Le patient est decede au Centre Hospitalier Prefectoral (CHP) de Kpalime [...] Au total 20 cas et 2 deces avaient ete enregistres, selon le dernier bilan communique le 27 septembre a l'Agence Savoir News par M.
